content: ProseMirror: EditorState holds schema plus an ordered plugin array and is a persistent data structure advanced only by transactions. PluginSpec is a plain data object with optional props, state (a StateField for plugin-owned state), key for keyed lookup, view returning a PluginView, filterTransaction, and appendTransaction. PluginView has an update/destroy lifecycle. View props resolve in order: direct props first, then plugins passed to the view, then plugins in the state. Extensibility with zero framework runtime.
